title: The anticancer potential of chemical constituents of Moringa oleifera targeting CDK-2 inhibition in estrogen receptor positive breast cancer using in-silico and in vitro approches.
authors: Sultan, Rida; Ahmed, Abrar; Wei, Li; Saeed, Hamid; Islam, Muhammad; Ishaq, Muhammad
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选辣木成分对CDK-2的抑制，靶点为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Most of the breast cancers are estrogen receptor-positive recurring with a steady rate of up to 20 years dysregulating the normal cell cycle. Dinaciclib is still in clinical trials and considered as a research drug against such cancers targeting CDK2.The major goal of this study was to identify the potential inhibitors of CDK-2 present in Moringa oleifera for treating hormonal receptor positive breast cancers. For this purpose, in silico techniques; molecular docking, MM-GBSA and molecular dynamics simulations were employed to screen Moringa oleifera compounds and their anticancer potential was determined against CDK-2 protein targets. Among 36 compounds of Moringa oleifera reported in literature, chlorogenic acid (1), quercetin (2), ellagic acid (3), niazirin (4), and kaempferol (5) showed good affinity with the target. The interaction of the compounds was visualized using PYMOL software. The profiles of absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion (ADME) and toxicity were determined using SWISS and ProTox II webservers. The MTT assay was performed in-vitro using MCF-7 cancer cell lines to validate the anticancer potential of Moringa oleifera leaf extract.MTT assay results revealed no significant change in proliferation of Mcf-7 cells following 24 h treatment with fraction A (petroleum ether). However, significant antiproliferative effect was observed at 200 microg/mL dose of fraction B (ethyl acetate) and cell viability was reduced to 40%.In conclusion, the data suggested that all the compounds with highest negative docking score than the reference could be the potential candidates for cyclin dependent kinase-2 (CDK-2) inhibition while ellagic acid, chlorogenic acid and quercetin being the most stable and potent inhibitors to treat estrogen receptor positive breast cancer targeting CDK-2. Moreover, the data suggested that further investigation is required to determine the optimum dose for significant antiproliferative effects using in-vivo models to validate our findings of in-silico analysis.
abstract_zh: 大多数乳腺癌为雌激素受体阳性，其复发率稳定，可持续长达20年，并扰乱正常细胞周期。Dinaciclib仍在临床试验阶段，被视为针对此类癌症靶向CDK2的研究药物。本研究的主要目标是鉴定辣木（Moringa oleifera）中存在的潜在CDK-2抑制剂，用于治疗激素受体阳性乳腺癌。为此，采用计算机模拟技术，包括分子对接、MM-GBSA和分子动力学模拟，筛选辣木化合物，并评估其针对CDK-2蛋白靶点的抗癌潜力。在文献报道的36种辣木化合物中，绿原酸（chlorogenic acid, 1）、槲皮素（quercetin, 2）、鞣花酸（ellagic acid, 3）、niazirin（4）和山柰酚（kaempferol, 5）与靶点表现出良好亲和力。使用PYMOL软件可视化化合物相互作用。利用SWISS和ProTox II网络服务器测定吸收、分布、代谢、排泄（ADME）和毒性特征。通过MCF-7癌细胞系进行体外MTT实验，以验证辣木叶提取物的抗癌潜力。MTT实验结果显示，用A组分（石油醚）处理24小时后，Mcf-7细胞增殖无显著变化。然而，在B组分（乙酸乙酯）200微克/毫升剂量下观察到显著抗增殖效应，细胞活力降至40%。总之，数据表明，所有对接分数低于参考化合物的化合物均可能成为细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶-2（CDK-2）抑制的潜在候选物，其中鞣花酸、绿原酸和槲皮素是最稳定且有效的抑制剂，可用于靶向CDK-2治疗雌激素受体阳性乳腺癌。此外，数据提示需进一步研究以确定最佳剂量，并通过体内模型验证我们的计算机模拟分析结果，以实现显著的抗增殖效应。
